name: bloodbridge-workspace
description: BloodBridge academic prototype — one-command Docker development

scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.ci:check: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build && npm run test:smoke
scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec db psql -U bloodbridge -d bloodbridge
scripts.db:check: docker compose exec -T db psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U bloodbridge -d bloodbridge -f /workspace/database/migrations/009_verify_advanced_objects.sql
